programs.title: Jamie's Super Food
programs.desc: In this programme, on the Greek island of Ikaria Jamie finds out how whole grain cracked wheat – which could be one of the reasons local people live so long – is prepared the traditional way and helps make a tasty Ikarian speciality, Trahana. Meanwhile, on the Japanese island of Okinawa, Jamie discovers the super food secrets behind local fruit, vegetables, herbs and spices and learns the islanders' belief in Nuchi Gusui – 'let food be your medicine' – from 95-year-old Shoei Kingo who incorporates all the health-giving food he grows into his diet to build a life bursting with vitality. Bringing what he's learnt back to the UK, Jamie creates a days' worth of super-nutritious and delicious meals, including: a super-charged 'health bomb' breakfast of Black Rice Pudding, Mango, Lime, Passion Fruit & Coconut; delicious Green Tea Roasted Salmon, Ginger Rice and Sunshine Salad for a lunch that will make you smile and beautiful Seared Turmeric Chicken, Houmous, Peppers, Couscous & Greens for d.

programs.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
programs.sub_title: Quick Fried Fish With Vegetable Acar
programs.desc: This fish dish is a prime example of how something well-seasoned can be the star of the show. Salt, turmeric and a little bit of stock powder are all you need. Alimah Bilda shares the full experience.

programs.title: Come Dine With Me The Professionals
programs.desc: Today we're in and around Birmingham and Wolverhampton and first up is Adians Dining where chef Adian and fiance and front of house manager Eloise are showcasing their Caribbean-Asian fusion menu.
